note.en: Read the kana before revealing or playing the answer. The meaning is context, not something to memorize. Accurate decoding counts even when it is slow. びょ · う · い · ん: four beats. Keep small ょ joined to び; preserve the long vowel.

note.en: Read the kana before revealing or playing the answer. The meaning is context, not something to memorize. Accurate decoding counts even when it is slow. きょ is one beat; the following う extends its o vowel by another beat.
note.fr: Lisez les kana avant de révéler ou d’écouter la réponse. Le sens fournit un contexte ; il n’est pas à mémoriser. Une lecture exacte suffit, même lente. きょ occupe un temps ; le う suivant prolonge sa voyelle o d’un temps.
